research.question: Does time of day change a weigh-in enough to matter; does an import carry a time; what is the error of a self-measured waist?
research.reason: Proposed health rules with numeric thresholds.
research.summary: Direction only for diurnal variation (Dittmar 2002); Health Connect weight is an instantaneous record; self-measured waist error about 1.9 cm at home (Barrios 2016; Verweij 2013). Sources listed in the report.
research.limitations: The WeightRecord class reference could not be retrieved.

research.question: Does a consistent weigh-in time steady a trend; do meal-anchored plans build a water habit; does daily weighing with feedback raise negative affect?
research.summary: No study on weigh-in time; one small trial against the water-habit claim (Rodger 2023); no harm on average from daily weighing in one RCT (Steinberg 2014). Sources listed in the report.

research.question: Is excess fluid an eating-disorder behaviour; does salient weighing worsen mood; is drink-to-thirst the consensus?
research.summary: Water loading and appetite-suppressing drinking are reported (Krogulska 2019; Hart 2011); self-weighing associates with worse affect in some groups (Pacanowski 2015). Sources listed in the report.
